context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 106 tested the RelationField component fix. All core functionality works: (1) relation-lookup endpoint returns correct format {results: [{id, label, sub}]}, (2) inventory lookup returns products with name/SKU, (3) invoices lookup returns invoices with invoiceNumber/buyerName, (4) custom panel lookup works, (5) auto-add Product/Invoice relation fields when linking to modules, (6) validation rejects invalid relation values. Frontend RelationField.tsx has debounced search (300ms), loading spinner, empty state, outside-click-to-close, resolved label display, and proper data-testid attributes. Minor edge cases: API returns 500 for missing target param (should handle gracefully), returns 200 for invalid panel ID (should return 404).
